_doc: Manual-only hero bios, keyed by campaign hero id (data/campaigns.json cast ids). title: an epithet shown after the class; bio: one or two spoiler-light sentences. Canon: docs/STORY.md.

hero_wren.title: Lord of Greyhold
hero_wren.bio: Great-grandson of Sir Orrin Wren, who died holding the gate of the Wound. Aldous holds a border town with what men he has and keeps calling for help that does not come.

hero_maelis.title: Ranger captain
hero_maelis.bio: Greyhold's ranger captain, the best shot on the river roads. She was carried off from a burned Thornwood village thirty years ago and does not answer to the name she was born with.

hero_edda.title: Lantern sister
hero_edda.bio: A sister of the lantern temples who reads the old records nobody else reads. Her lamp burns blue near the dead.

hero_ysmay.title: The Unburied Regent
hero_ysmay.bio: Ruler of Sallowmere for three hundred years. She is not cruel and not kind; she is the only one of the dead who still makes plans.

hero_orrin.title: The knight who came back
hero_orrin.bio: Sir Orrin Wren held the gate at the Sealing and died there. A hundred years later the warm earth gives him back.

hero_corvin.title: Father of the fens
hero_corvin.bio: A plague-priest of Sallowmere who tends the dead the way a shepherd tends sheep, and asks them nothing.

hero_skarn.title: Pit-chief of the Gnawing Pit
hero_skarn.bio: A demon with nothing, who climbs out of the starving broods and makes them one Host again by eating whoever disagrees.

hero_ithra.title: Reader of cracks
hero_ithra.bio: A warlock who reads the Lockstone's fractures like a script, and the only one in the Host who looks south as often as west.

hero_morvath.title: The Kindler
hero_morvath.bio: A tormentor who loves fire for its own sake. When the Host needs a seal broken or a forest burned, Morvath carries the torch.

hero_cerrid.title: Grovewarden of the Last Grove
hero_cerrid.bio: A warden of the Elderwold who goes to war for the last stand of trees, and finds his sister on the other side of it.

hero_neve.title: Huntmaster
hero_neve.bio: The Covenant's best tracker. She follows the clans' raiders into the snow and comes back with questions.

hero_brakka.title: Old Mother of the druids
hero_brakka.bio: The eldest Thornspeaker, who knows what the Heartroots were for and has known for forty years.

hero_gunnra.title: Runesmith of Stonevow
hero_gunnra.bio: The only smith in the Forge who believes the rock will not keep the fire out, and the first to go down into the old seams to find out why.

hero_dask.title: Ironmarshal
hero_dask.bio: Commander of the Forge's gate-wardens. He keeps the gates shut because the council told him to, and keeps them well.

hero_tobbin.title: Master artificer
hero_tobbin.bio: An engineer whose forbidden engine was buried with the Fallen Hold. He has been waiting a long time for someone to ask for it.

hero_ulvra.title: Thane of Kettlehall
hero_ulvra.bio: The thane who unites the clans by the axe when the summer fails, and leads them south for bread.

hero_bjarr.title: Reaver
hero_bjarr.bio: Ulvra's oldest shield-brother, a raider who has crossed the Iron Pass more times than he can count.

hero_iska.title: Seer of the Rime
hero_iska.bio: A frost-seer who reads the sky and is the first to say aloud that this summer was stolen.

hero_serane.title: Dreadmarshal of the Nightgate Wardens
hero_serane.bio: A young commander of the Umbral Court, sent up the Long Stair to free the surface peoples from the Gate-Eyes and bring the Eyes home.

hero_rhuvel.title: Nightstalker
hero_rhuvel.bio: A scout who has been to the surface before and doubts everything he was told about it.

hero_ulmarra.title: Matriarch and Veilseer
hero_ulmarra.bio: The Veilseer of the Nightgate Wardens, who always says the same thing: bring it home.

hero_ilo.title: Ilo Who Reads
hero_ilo.bio: The only one of the Shoal who can read the tablets of drowned Sarranth, and learns from them what his people were.

hero_thunn.title: Reefbreaker
hero_thunn.bio: Ilo's friend and the Shoal's war-leader, who stands with him when the chiefs forbid what he read.

hero_sael.title: Hookhand
hero_sael.bio: A reef hunter who joins Ilo late and asks the questions he does not want to answer.
